name: Bottles and Baubles

aliases: what are bottles and baubles for
faq.answer: The angler believes that whatever attracts a murloc may also attract fish beneath the water. Since murlocs look like fish, the angler reasons that their minds work alike, and shiny trinkets from their camps could make bait.
faq.q: Why do you need to collect junk from murlocs?

faq.answer: The shiny junk lies in a nearby murloc camp. Murlocs hoard glittering debris, discarded trinkets, and glass along shorelines and waterways.
faq.q: Where is the shiny junk found?

faq.answer: A local angler asks for the work, hoping to stock up on lures and bait. The angler offers surplus fishing gear to helpful scavengers and beginners.
faq.q: Who gives this task and what do they want?

faq.answer: The angler believes murlocs think like fish, but murlocs are amphibious tribal humanoids. They are drawn to gleaming items, polished shells, and bright trinkets, while their hoard piles happen to hold glittering materials.
faq.q: Do murlocs actually think like fish?

aliases: what is shiny junk used for
does murloc junk work as bait
faq.answer: The angler plans to fashion reflective glass, metal bits, and polished odds and ends into lures and improvised bait. Their sheen may mimic small minnows or catch the curiosity of feeding fish.
faq.q: How will the murloc junk be used as bait?

faq.answer: After you bring back enough suitable shiny scraps, the angler gives you older personal angling supplies. The basic tools and provisions help aspiring fishermen try their hand at the waters.
faq.q: What does the questgiver offer as a reward?

sections.body: An eccentric angler has a theory about murlocs and fish. Murlocs look like fish, so the angler reasons that their minds work alike. Whatever catches a murloc's eye may tempt a hungry fish on a hook. You search a nearby murloc camp, sifting through its hoards for shiny discarded junk to test the idea.
sections.title: Fish Logic and Shoreline Scavenging

sections.body: Along coasts and riverbanks, murlocs gather bright stones, shells, polished glass, and metal scraps in messy piles around their huts. Sifting through the muddy heaps turns up glittering refuse that an angler can shape into crude lures and flashers. The finds satisfy the angler enough to earn you starter fishing supplies.
sections.title: Gleaming Baubles as Bait

summary: An angler wants to try a curious theory with murloc trinkets. Their shine may draw fish to the hook.
